body: Spatial reasoning remains a persistent weakness of vision-language models (VLMs), because RGB inputs do not directly provide geometric evidence. Existing remedies either inject 3D into the model at inference, paying architecture and latency costs, or train with outcome rewards that supervise only the final answer. Spatial errors originate in perception: a misjudged depth or direction can be corrected only by the scene's true geometry, which the 3D-scanned sources of spatial training corpora already provide. We propose GPD (Geometry-Privileged Distillation), which makes geometric evidence the privilege in on-policy self-distillation (OPSD). For each question, depth, semantic, and bird's-eye-view (BEV) cues are rendered as compact text and routed to the teacher alongside the reference answer; a privileged KL, applied only to incorrect trajectories, augments GRPO, and the deployed model remains RGB-only. On the 4B backbone, GPD achieves 57.1 on VSI-Bench and 37.6 average across MindCube, SPARBench, MMSI-Bench, and ViewSpatial, outperforming both GRPO and answer-privileged OPSD across spatial reasoning benchmarks. Ablations confirm the complementarity of 3D and answer privilege, the advantage of question-conditioned routing over full-context injection, and the benefit of restricting distillation to incorrect trajectories.
summaryZh: 空间理解能力一直是视觉语言模型（VLM）的持久弱点，因为RGB输入无法直接提供几何证据。以往的补救方法要么在推理时注入3D信息带来架构和延迟开销，要么使用仅监督最终答案的结果奖励。本文提出了GPD（Geometry-Privileged Distillation，几何特权蒸馏）方法，将几何证据作为在线自蒸馏中的特权信息。对于每个问题，深度、语义和鸟瞰图（BEV）线索被渲染为紧凑文本并路由给教师模型，特权KL散度被施加于错误轨迹上以增强强化学习，而部署后的模型保持纯RGB输入。在多个空间推理基准测试中，该方法在4B骨干网上取得了优异成绩，验证了几何特权的有效性。

aiReview.reasonZh: 提出GPD几何特权蒸馏方法，通过在训练中引入深度与BEV几何线索，显著提升了视觉语言模型在推理时的纯RGB空间理解能力。

glossary.explanationZh: 几何特权蒸馏，一种在训练阶段引入3D几何监督信息、推理时保持纯RGB输入的视觉大模型蒸馏方法
空间推理，指理解和推断物体在三维空间中的位置、深度和方向关系的能力
鸟瞰图，从上方俯视场景的视角，常用于自动驾驶和空间几何感知
在线策略自蒸馏，利用模型自身在当前策略下生成的样本和反馈进行知识蒸馏的技术
视觉空间智能基准测试，用于评估多模态大模型空间推理能力的评测集
